title: Belvedere
html_source: Belvedere College, where the sons of Mr David Sheehy, MP, also attended. Father Conmee had just greeted Mrs Sheehy shortly before. The school is about 330 yards in a mostly straight line southwest from the point on Mountjoy Square where the priest meets them.
